document.title: 2019 Shizuoka high-precision 3D map utilization report, attachment 3: hybrid data product specification

limitations: Downloaded XYZ grids have no individual datum metadata.
Hybrid product specification provides project-level provenance; not independent certification of each downloaded file.
GSI comparisons differ in acquisition epoch and possibly 2025 height revision; they do not justify applying a constant correction.
No measured local tide or event source has been inferred.
All scenario outputs must remain experimental and unvalidated against real tsunami observations.
固定した波形・潮位・方向による条件計算です。実際の津波に対する予測精度は未検証です。
枠の外は未計算です。色がない場所の安全を示すものではありません。
地形の細かさで結果が変わります。建物単位の損傷や防潮堤の効果を保証しません。
